text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing signs of fatigue in Narita Brian, I 
decided to let her rest in the infirmary, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Got it... I'm gonna go take a nap. See ya.
Hey, wake up...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch... What do you want?! Interrupting 
someone's sleep like that!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Where are we!? And there's nobody 
here...

Sorry to interrupt your shock, but look 
down.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Wha--!? My shadow is moving...!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian's Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Greetings, other self. Getting straight to 
the point, care for a match with me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian's Shadow
text_block_list.text:
If I win, I get my freedom. If you win, 
I'll quietly return to playing the 
shadow... Deal?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Heh, talk big for a mere shadow... Fine 
then. I accept your challenge!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Let's go! Shadows belong in the dark—now 
follow my lead!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian's Shadow
text_block_list.text:
I'll teach you how terrifying the shadows 
can be!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: This is true strength!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian's Shadow
text_block_list.text: Man... you've completely bested me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian's Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Understood, it's a promise. I'll return to 
my original role. That was fun. Let's run 
together again sometime.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...We run together all the time, don't we?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian's Shadow
text_block_list.text:
...Haha. I see, that's certainly true. 
Well then, I look forward to working with 
you. I'm expecting a great run.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Heh... A great run, you say? Leave it to 
me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to a refreshing dream, it seems 
Narita Brian was able to get a proper 
rest.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Wh-Why can't I catch up...?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian's Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I win, doesn't it? Then, as 
promised, I'll take my freedom.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: W-Wait...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian's Shadow
text_block_list.text: If you want me to wait, try catching up!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Gasp?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
There's a shadow, but... damn it! To think 
I'd lose to my own shadow...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because of that strange dream, it seems 
Narita Brian was unable to get a proper 
rest.
